Hyphenation patterns from the hyph-utf8 package
(https://github.com/hyphenation/tex-hyphen, http://www.hyphenation.org/tex)

jade-docx-layout ships these pattern files unmodified, in
crates/jade-docx-layout/src/hyphenation/, each with its own header carrying
its copyright and licence notice:

  hyph-en-us.tex    American English
                    Copyright (C) 1990, 2004, 2005 Gerard D.C. Kuiken
                    "Copying and distribution of this file, with or without
                    modification, are permitted in any medium without royalty
                    provided the copyright notice and this notice are
                    preserved."
  hyph-en-gb.tex    British English
                    Copyright (C) 1992, 1996, 2005, 2016 Dominik Wujastyk,
                    Graham Toal. MIT licence.
  hyph-de-1996.tex  German, reformed (1996) spelling
                    Copyright (c) 2013-2024 Stephan Hennig, Werner Lemberg,
                    Günter Milde, Sander van Geloven, Georg Pfeiffer, Gisbert
                    W. Selke, Tobias Wendorf, Keno Wehr. MIT licence.
  hyph-fr.tex       French
                    Copyright (C) 1994-2002 Daniel Flipo, Bernard Gaulle,
                    2016 Arthur Reutenauer. MIT licence.
  hyph-es.tex       Spanish
                    Copyright (C) 1993, 1997 Javier Bezos, 2001-2019 Javier
                    Bezos, CervanTeX. MIT licence.
  hyph-nl.tex       Dutch
                    Copyright (C) 1996 Piet Tutelaers. MIT licence.
  hyph-it.tex       Italian
                    Copyright (C) 2008-2011 Claudio Beccari. Available under
                    the LaTeX Project Public License 1.3 or the MIT licence;
                    used here under the MIT licence.
